feature: Upstream Intake 2026-09 — UP-04 lane B (needs you)

userStories.title: The `needs-you` fragment and its authoring rule (#266, PRD D-13)
userStories.description: New ARC-039 fragment src/assets/.arcane/spells/_fragments/needs-you.md defining ONE unmistakable block for required operator actions in spell output: a fixed heading (e.g. `## ⚠ Needs you`), placed before optional next steps, one line per action naming exactly what to do and why it cannot be done by the agent, and the rule that an action required for correctness is never listed only among optional suggestions; when nothing is required the block is omitted (not an empty block). Add the convention to src/assets/.arcane/governance/spell-authoring-standards.md with an ARC-023 enforcement annotation. Do NOT use `{UPPER_SNAKE}` tokens outside code (the placeholder check counts them).
acceptanceCriteria: spell-authoring-standards documents the convention with an enforcement annotation
test asserts the fragment's heading, placement and omit-when-empty rules
userStories.testEvidence: New fragment src/assets/.arcane/spells/_fragments/needs-you.md (heading `## ⚠ Needs you`, top of the final report before optional steps, one line per action, never only among optional steps, omitted when empty, early-stop reports, ARC-023 advisory annotation). New section 'Required operator actions: the `Needs you` block' in spell-authoring-standards.md with an ARC-023 enforcement annotation. test/up04-b-needs-you.test.ts 14/14 pass; mutation check (deleting the placement and omit rules) failed 2 tests as intended, then restored. fix/check:self-host-parity pass (328 items; fragment is picked up from _fragments/ automatically, no spell references it until UP04-B-02); check:citations output identical to base; check:adr-references pass; check:stale-claims exit 0; related tests (spell-compiler, user-tier, up02-b-*, up02-d-*, doctor-placeholders, cicd-fail-safe-path-filters) 189/189 pass.

userStories.title: Expand the fragment into every spell that ends with required operator actions
userStories.description: Survey all canonical spells under src/assets/.arcane/spells/ and select those whose output can contain an action only the operator can take (approve or merge a PR, accept an ADR, answer a question, run an interactive command such as `spell unblock-push`, an external/platform step). At minimum evaluate: spell-open-session, spell-close-session, spell-commit-work, spell-create-pull-request, spell-sync-pull-request, spell-address-review, spell-ship, spell-full-cycle, spell-arcane-version, spell-bump, spell-review, spell-review-batch, spell-architect, spell-plan. Add the fragment marker pair where that spell describes its output/report, then `npm run fix:self-host-parity`. Record the chosen set and the reason for each exclusion in the story's testEvidence. Never edit inside another fragment's span; don't change frontmatter.
acceptanceCriteria: every chosen spell carries exactly one fragment span, fully expanded
userStories.testEvidence: Span added where each spell describes its final output, then fix:self-host-parity (fragments: 15, copies: 15; check passes, 343 items). INCLUDED (15): spell-open-session (output can carry Pending Verification actions, clarifications, `spell unblock-push`); spell-close-session (unrouted lessons need a yes, human merge, unverifiable items need an operator check); spell-commit-work (guarded push confirmation, blocked push, second human approval, merge gate); spell-create-pull-request (human completion below Magus, unresolved reviewers, pending push); spell-sync-pull-request (ambiguous conflict needs manual resolution, push confirmation); spell-address-review (threads needing manual resolution by reviewer/operator); spell-ship (explicit human approval, production and Terraform-destroy approvals); spell-full-cycle (HUMAN GATE on PR ID + head SHA, disclosed manual steps); spell-review (DEFER needs human decision; self-authored blocking review needs a distinct reviewer); spell-review-batch (NO-GO from skipped PRs, CLI auth remediation only the operator can run); spell-architect (PRD gaps to answer, new decision records to accept); spell-plan (PRD approval, Open Questions needing human decision); spell-scope (Open Questions and decision-record candidates needing human decision); spell-adopt-docs (Flagged items need operator decisions); spell-make-discoverable (webmaster-console values and manual DNS changes only the operator can make). EXCLUDED: spell-arcane-version (read-only status report; update notices are optional and skipped setup questions are asked in-flow); spell-bump (no operator-only step; its commit goes through spell-commit-work, which carries the block); spell-eas-store-deploy (operator-only console steps exist but the spell has no final output/report section to place the span in; flagged as a follow-up candidate); spell-implement (a stuck story is recorded in stories.json and is not operator-only); spell-product-review (the whole report is a decision aid by design; nothing is blocked on the operator for correctness); every other spell (approvals are in-flow gates, not actions left at the end of the run). Never inside push-policy-check or tracking-mode-declaration spans (asserted). test/up04-b-needs-you.test.ts 90/90 (one pair per chosen spell, expanded/idempotent, placed after the output anchor, not nested, root copy equal, carrying set == chosen set, excluded set carries none). check:citations output identical to base; check:adr-references pass; check:stale-claims exit 0 with the same 10-line report as base; the 38 existing test files that mention any touched spell: 805 passed, 1 skipped. Integration (UP-04 adversarial review R4): spell-eas-store-deploy moved from excluded to included; a new `### Reporting the release` section before `## Rules` carries the span, because its store-console steps (sending staged Google Play changes for review) are operator-only actions #266 covers. 16 spells carry the span.

userStories.title: Required actions survive the session handoff
userStories.description: spell-close-session's `## Next Session Handoff` template gains a `Needs you` field (required operator actions, or `None`), carried into the handoff; spell-open-session's Handoff Detection surfaces that field FIRST, before `Picking Up From Last Session` content, and does not mark the handoff consumed without surfacing it. Keep the existing handoff field names and the Pending Verification behaviour unchanged (tests assert them).
userStories.testEvidence: spell-close-session's handoff template gains `- **Needs you:**` between `Pending Verification` and `Notes` (same items as the closure report's `## ⚠ Needs you` block, "None" when empty, never only in Blockers/Notes/Carry Forward); no field renamed. spell-open-session's Handoff Detection gains a bullet: surface the field in the `## ⚠ Needs you` block above `## Picking Up From Last Session`, check items it can, treat a pre-field handoff as None, and do not mark the handoff consumed until every item is surfaced. spell-authoring-standards.md records the handoff rule. The fresh-install scaffold src/assets/ai-context/system-prompt-context.md is outside this lane's allowlist and was not changed (it ships pre-consumed; the absent field reads as None). test/up04-b-handoff.test.ts 11/11 (field order pinned: the 8 existing names plus Needs you); prompt-handoff-durability and prompt-pending-verification pass unchanged; fix/check:self-host-parity pass (343); check:citations identical to base; check:adr-references pass; check:stale-claims exit 0, same 10-line report; 28 test files mentioning open/close-session, the standards or _fragments: 628/628 pass.
